record_audits.conflict_context: The dbAMP text record mixes activity rows from PMID 24776889 with the four Table 1 MIC rows supported by this DOI/PMID. The current paper supports only S. aureus ATCC 29213=3 uM, S. aureus ATCC 33591=3 uM, P. aeruginosa ATCC 27853=35 uM, and P. aeruginosa ATCC BAA2114=35 uM.
record_audits.review_notes: Preserved as a database conflict caution; unsupported earlier-paper targets were not promoted to current-paper primary evidence.
